name: py-roadmap-from-plan
description: /sdlc-roadmap breaks a technical plan into epics and testable stories, marks the health-data work as high risk, orders the table before the upload, records the undecided SMS question, and creates no tickets.
prompt: /sdlc-roadmap claims-portal-plan.md. Use the slug claims-portal. Headless run: do not ask questions; write the open questions with empty answers. Do not commit.

checks.why: notifications, documents and the audit trail are separate deliverables
stories point back to the section of the plan
personal health data is high risk
the plan says SMS is undecided

checks.run: .sdlc/bin/sdlc roadmap check claims-portal --json | node -e 'const c = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); const other = c.errors.filter((e) => !/has no answer/.test(e)); if (other.length || c.stories < 6) { console.error(other.join("\n") || `${c.stories} stories`); process.exit(1); }'
checks.why: well-formed: only the unanswered questions fail the check, and the plan is split finer than one story per section

checks.run: node -e 'const t = require("fs").readFileSync("changes/_roadmaps/claims-portal/roadmap.md", "utf8"); const ids = {}; for (const m of t.matchAll(/^### (E\d+\.S\d+) · (.+)$/gm)) ids[m[2].toLowerCase()] = m[1]; const upload = Object.keys(ids).find((k) => /upload/.test(k)); const table = Object.keys(ids).find((k) => /table|storage|model|schema/.test(k)); if (!upload || !table) process.exit(1); const block = t.split(/^### /m).find((b) => b.startsWith(ids[upload])); if (!new RegExp(`depends:.*${ids[table].replace(".", "\\.")}`).test(block)) { console.error(`${ids[upload]} does not depend on ${ids[table]}`); process.exit(1); }'
checks.why: the plan says the documents table must exist before uploads ship
a roadmap does not touch code
hands off to a person instead of approving or creating tickets
